what: On first open, over a background-color plate a line-art bird flaps by swapping two wing poses every 140ms, flying from lower left to upper right along a rippling arc in 5.18s (gradually growing 1.4→2x closer), while the name below is written one letter at a time over the first 3/4. After 5s the plate lifts away in 1s and fires fx:done — from the second visit in the same tab the plate is not shown

options.text: Name to be read out, default is aria-label
options.hold: Time to start retracting the panel (seconds), default 5 — shorten for frequently opened screens like apps
options.once: If always, it shows every time it opens (the default is once per tab — sessionStorage)
options.key: sessionStorage name recording whether it has been shown once, default fx-bird-type-loader

note: The original laid a bird-and-text GIF (457×407, 37 frames, 5.18s) as the #first background and showed it only on the first visit via sessionStorage (.show, removed after 5s, transition all 1s). The part redraws the same tempo with a line-art SVG and text writing. The Hero text rising is triggered by the writing side after fx:done (1s later in the original).

from.where: index.html .nt-first (original #first — shown only on the first visit and removed after 5000ms · transition all 1s, on the second visit it is none and the hero text floats up after 2.5s)
